## About
Hoss Roofing & General Contracting is a local DFW company based in McKinney, run by owner Jestin Ross. We handle roofing and general contracting for residential and multi-family homes, start to finish, so you don't need multiple contractors coming into your home.
Our crew members have been with us since we started the company. That means the same people, the same system and consistent work from home to home. We pull all required permits on every job, and we'd rather educate you than sell you, so you can make the best decision for your home.
We don't take a deposit or any money upfront. You pay when the project is complete and you're happy with it, and every roof system is backed by our Craftsman Labor Warranty.
We're an A+ BBB accredited company, rated 5 on Google from 174 reviews. Robert told us we were clean and communicated well, and Mary said Jestin kept them updated daily. Call to schedule your free inspection.

## Services
- New Roofing Systems: Complete roof replacements, backed by a 7 Year Craftsman Labor Warranty on every roof system.
- Drone Inspections: Expert drone inspections using the newest technology, so you can see the damage on your roof for yourself.
- Gutters: Gutter system installs to go with your roof or on their own.
- Paint / Trim: Interior and exterior paint and trim work, from a single room to the outside of the house.
- Interior / Exterior Remodeling: Remodeling inside and out, handled by one general contractor from start to finish.
- Flooring: Floor replacement, often done alongside a remodel or interior paint job.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take a deposit?
A: No. We don't collect any money until the project is complete and done to your satisfaction.

Q: Is the inspection free?
A: Yes. Give us a call to schedule your free inspection.

Q: Someone called me about storm damage claiming to be you. Was it you?
A: No. We do not cold call or solicit storm damage work, and we only contact customers from our official number. If you're ever unsure, call us directly to verify.

Q: Do you pull permits?
A: Yes. We pull all required permits on every job, so you know we don't cut corners.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes. Our services are custom tailored to each client and by appointment only.

Q: Are you insured?
A: Yes. We are insured up to $2,000,000.00.
